title: GP-Sync
description: Plugin that syncs bonus and accumulated Claim Blocks from GriefProtection across multiple Velocity servers via MariaDB. Limited support.
body: Works by syncing total Bonus and Accumulated claim blocks from each player. Highest value wins, local and shared DBs update every time a player joins or leaves. Does not factor in claim blocks spent on any server, only earned claimblocks. Purpose built for my server network. Developed for 1.21.11, not guaranteed to work on any other version. Should work with MySQL, but I have only tested with MariaDB. Due to limited time, I will not be doing much with this plugin other than ensuring bugs are fixed promptly and updating versions as I update my network. Source code will be made public in the near future.
